name: Fpl
description: Fantasy Premier League squad checker and optimiser: point predictions, transfer and captain suggestions, and a data-driven optimal squad builder.

paragraphs: A Fantasy Premier League (FPL) squad checker and optimiser. Load your squad, see point predictions for every player, get transfer and captain suggestions, or generate a data-driven "optimal" squad for any gameweek.
features: Three ways to load a squad — enter an FPL team ID, upload a screenshot of your team (read on your device with OCR — no AI service or upload — then matched to FPL players and priced from live FPL data), or build one from…

Point predictions for every player, with a per-player "Why?" breakdown showing exactly which inputs drove the number (FPL's own model, form, set pieces, xG/xA, bookmaker odds, fixture difficulty, availability, rest…
Optimal squad builder — picks the best 15 within a £100m budget, aware of who actually starts vs. sits on the bench so budget isn't wasted on players who won't play.
Transfer suggestions that account for free transfers vs. the -4 point hit, so a marginal swap isn't recommended if it costs you points.
Captain and vice-captain suggestions, plus click-to-edit captaincy on any squad.

whatItDoes.text: A Fantasy Premier League (FPL) squad checker and optimiser. Load your squad, see point predictions for every player, get transfer and captain suggestions, or generate a data-driven "optimal" squad for any gameweek.
